thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: page fired — HIGH latency observed for /v1/generate (PD-8921). current state: firing. urgency: P2. link: https://pd.example/PD-8921

alex: acked. looking now. any visible errors?

jen: +1 on ack. i'll open metrics while alex digs logs.

sam: i'm seeing a short jump in tail latency from ~80ms -> 1.2s across a small subset of hosts around 10:02. no increase in 5xx. throughput steady.

alex: pulled tracer and tail logs, found a handful of requests stuck waiting on redis-timeout 200ms -> 1s. suspect KV cold miss cascade. attaching quick grep: ```2026-03-15T10:02:14Z host-34: request_id=abc123 rpc:kv-get timeout after 200ms```

lina: thanks — any customer-facing errors? CS saying one customer reported slow response for embeddings job but no failures.

sam: correct, only latency. p50/p95 back to normal for most tenants except a small shard (pool-7).

incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert auto-resolved (PD-8921) — reason: firing cleared by monitor.

alex: odd, we didn't change config. prob transient. I'll leave open in thread for 5m then close if no repro.

jen: I suggest add narrow suppressor on that alert for 2m to avoid flapping while we investigate.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: page fired again — HIGH latency on /v1/generate (PD-8921).

alex: acked again. looks like a noisy signal (short lived). I'm going to check autoscaler/eviction events.

sam: autoscaler shows two quick scale-down/ups at 10:01:46 -> 10:02:10 in pool-7. probably a pod bounce causing KV cache cold starts.

jen: can we pin concurrency on that pool temporarily to avoid thrash? we should also mute the global page and create a pool-scoped alert.

alex: doing temporary silence on PD for 10m and adding pool-scoped alert ticket. muting global now. :mute:

lina: updated CS: told them we're aware, no request failures, working on mitigation. they appreciated the quick update. :thumbsup:

sam: quick mitigation notes — increased pod minReplicas for pool-7 from 2 -> 4, added a small KV pre-warm on startup (will roll in canary).

alex: after scale-up and pre-warm tweak, latency back to normal on the shard. no customer errors. patching autoscaler policy to reduce aggressive scale-down on small pools.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert auto-resolved (PD-8921) — cleared.

jen: handoff — alex, if it reappears in next 30m please escalate to infra oncall @sam, otherwise i'll take follow-up tomorrow for permanent rule change.

alex: ack. leaving note in ops-runbook and will file a follow-up RFC for alert granularity + autoscaler cadence.

lina: thanks team — good quick coordination.

sam: follow-ups: (1) create PD rule for pool-level threshold, (2) reduce scale-down aggressiveness, (3) add KV warmup job. I'll open the PRs and link here.

alex: created task https://rdo/internal/ticket/INF-4122 — references the changes.

jen: closing thread once we confirm no re-fires. closing comment: brief noisy/flapping pages caused by rapid scale-down/up leading to KV cold misses; mitigated by short silence, increasing minReplicas, and pre-warm. no customer-impacting errors reported. :white_check_mark:
